maddeler.e:
يقترعوا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَرِعُوا (yaqtariʕū) /jaq.ta.ri.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# يُقْتَرَعُوا (yuqtaraʕū) /juq.ta.ra.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
